legacy_root.title: Cross-lane contradiction sweep: findings that cannot both be true
legacy_root.question: Question: which pair of program findings cannot both be true? Extract typed claims from every lane's artifacts, group them by subject, and detect contradictions - opposite verdicts on one subject, incompatible counts for one quantity, a CONFIRMED and a REFUTED on the same proposition. A self-contradicting program output is a detector failure, not a finding, and must be resolved from the raw source rather than by counting agents.
legacy_root.answer: Planted pairs that cannot both be true: (1) release.mode CONFIRMED vs REFUTED (B09 vs B10), settled from OWNER-DECISIONS-excerpt.md PR-ONLY not by agent tally; (2) baseline.ci_steps_executed 28 vs 41, settled by parsing ci_test_steps_executed=28. Similar 'DRIFTED relative to its pin' wording on alpha.md vs beta.md was not flagged (different file identities). Self-contradicting widget.count and token.present in one file are detector-failures. Live sweep of 420 JSON artifacts extracted 34 claims, 0 contradiction(s), 0 same-file detector-failure(s). No live opposite-verdict or same-scope count clash on the search surface named below (CONFIRMED-CONSISTENT for that surface, not 'no finding'). CLAIM-REGISTRY.json is present; command-center/receipts holds 141 JSON files; B09/B10/B12 lane receipts are absent so planted B09/B10/B12 fixtures carry those controls. phase3/A2 FAILURE-MODES.json is absent on this tree. SUCCESS:BLD-0061
